name: Nexalis Therapeutics Limited
summary: Nexalis Therapeutics Limited, formerly InhaleRx Limited, is a biotechnology company developing inhaled drug-device combinations in Australia. Its candidates are IRX-211 for breakthrough cancer pain and IRX-616a for panic disorder, both delivered through a pressurised metered dose inhaler, and SRX-25 for treatment-resistant depression. It was incorporated in 2016 and has its base in Melbourne.
